_comment: LinesOfAction locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Never translate board coordinates (a-h, 1-8), piece letters (O, X), the move-format token, or the {board} ASCII grid.

_slots.{side}: The player's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{other}: The opponent's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{board}: The ASCII rendering of the board; keep as-is
_slots.{coord}: A board coordinate such as b1 or a3
_slots.{from}: The source coordinate of a move, such as b1
_slots.{to}: The destination coordinate of a move, such as b3

player_prompt.intro:
D kemm wemarir {player_id} deg urar n LinesOfAction.
Iɣallen-ik d '{side}', iɣallen n wemsebrir d '{other}'.
Format n usenqed: `[b1b3]` (tisurta n uẓeṭṭa n usenqed). Usenqed usrid yettawi s uḍḍun, s aɣella, neɣ s uɣella n iɣallen (nnayn n yini) deg wakal-ik. Tzemreḍ ad tɛeddiɣ ɣef iɣallen-ik, maca ur tɛeddiɣ ara ɣef iɣallen n wemsebrir; asenqed ɣef wemsebrir ad yeṭṭfeɣ-it.  Irem-d wemarir miṣaṣ iɣallen-ik d-qqnen ɣer 8 n iɣallen.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Asebtar-a ilaq ad yili d e2e4 (si, ɣer tdukliwin).
invalid_move.not_straight_or_diagonal: Azal-is ilaq ad yili d azegrar neɣ n tnezzut.
invalid_move.wrong_distance: Ilaq ad yeddu s temnaḍt yemgaraden ɣer yiferrawen deg yiwet n tgara.
invalid_move.destination_own: Uẓeṭṭa n usenqed yettwasenqed sɣur iɣallen-ik.

game_action.captured_suffix: Player {player_id} yefɣen {from} -> {to} akken ad yesselḥu aɣella n uɛdew.
